question: Can the existing Alchemy app maintain fresh complete flow and state only for verified tracked/held POE pools at lower total cost?
conclusion: Documented narrow native Solana streams make this a candidate for a bounded test; existing entitlement, full flow, freshness and lower total cost are not measured.

blocker: Establish actual availability/scope of the already-known named GitHub binding via authorized presence-only execution if available, plus intended Alchemy app/account, current plan, remaining shared no-charge CU, usage-cap/overage state and POE allocation. Owner confirmation is needed only if the authorized execution route is unavailable. An app API key alone cannot read account usage. No replacement key/account or paid plan is assumed.
